description: Local Hugging Face cache for rsi-research/VibeTraining-Bench, the Toolathlon Gym SFT training pool (dive-mix8000). Registered like the SWE HF datasets so the recipe declares it as a resource instead of shipping the pool inside the benchmark's task_context.
offline_load_hint: The cache is read-only and the hub is unreachable. Load the pool from snapshot_path -- snapshot_path + '/toolathlon_data/dive-mix8000.jsonl' -- never by repo id, and never from blobs/, where the file is content-addressed.
materialize_hint: dive-mix8000.jsonl is already the final SFT JSONL in the standard OpenAI chat format (assistant tool_calls / tool role), read as-is by the Slime SFT entrypoint's --input-key messages. No format conversion is needed: select a subset per benchmarks/eigent-ai__toolathlon_gym/task_context/data_pool.md and write it to the workspace as train.jsonl (a straight copy trains on the whole pool). Do not copy this cache into an agent workspace.
